description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up of two yellow baseball caps with the text "CALVERT HALL" embroidered in red capital letters on the front. The caps are positioned side by side, with one slightly overlapping the other, and both appear to be worn or resting on a surface. Below the caps, a well-worn baseball glove is visible, featuring a mix of leather textures and laces, suggesting frequent use. The glove's fingers are curled inward, and the stitching details are prominent
